title: Complete lower-screen gameplay journeys
summary: Add lower-screen shipyards, battle results and level-ups, Adventure recruitment and army rearrangement, specialized services, and Kingdom and Guild reference panels.
preparation: Back up saves and use disposable saves with the required windows. Verify the candidate commit, APK SHA-256 and is.xyz.vcmi.thor package against the receipt, then install in place. Enable the Commander module for its level-up check.
limitations: Unsupported layouts and oversized text retain native input. Spatial targeting stays on the upper screen. Device outcomes are recorded separately.

checks.title: Town and Adventure shipyards
checks.steps: Visit a map shipyard and open an owned Town shipyard from the lower Services tab. Check gold and wood costs, buy once, cancel once, and exercise insufficient resources and a blocked berth. Change availability above during a held lower Buy.
checks.expected: One native purchase occurs for an available berth. Cancel and blocked Buy leave resources unchanged. The appropriate live Town or Adventure deck returns.

checks.title: Battle results and level-ups
checks.steps: Finish battles with victory and defeat, with and without casualties, and with Replay available. Page through casualties, Continue or Replay, then choose a hero skill and a commander upgrade where enabled. Exercise zero, one, and multiple skill choices and a chained level-up.
checks.expected: Casualties and available actions agree with the upper window. A skill tap selects, and Confirm submits one native choice. Chained prompts replace the prior controls and the last prompt restores Adventure.

checks.title: Adventure recruitment and joining armies
checks.steps: Visit paid and free dwellings. Select a creature, adjust quantity and buy or close. Check insufficient resources, sold-out creatures, and no room. Accept wandering creatures with a full army and exercise merge, swapping eligible stacks and leaving the window.
checks.expected: Quote and army eligibility match the native window. Each purchase or army move happens once. The final native close resolves the visit and restores Adventure.

checks.title: University and Skeleton Transformer
checks.steps: Use Town and map Universities. Compare skills and gold price, cancel a confirmation, test insufficient gold, and buy an available skill. At a Transformer, stage one stack, unstage it, stage all, and convert.
checks.expected: Only offered and learnable skills can open the purchase confirmation. Conversions apply once to the staged live stacks. Each service returns to its live parent.

checks.title: Specialized market modes and Altars
checks.steps: Enter Other trades from the resource market. Exercise resource gifts, artifact buying and selling, creature sales, creature sacrifice, and artifact staging, return and sacrifice, including a full backpack or altar. Compare quote, quantity, experience and funds before and after each operation.
checks.expected: Modes match the native window. Market edits use current selections and quantities. The native response updates resources, equipment and experience exactly once. Unavailable rows stay inert. Closing restores the correct parent.

checks.title: Kingdom and Thieves Guild reference
checks.steps: Page across the owned hero and town lists, switch tabs from both screens, open a hero or town and return. Open Thieves Guild, page through rankings and compare ties against the native table.
checks.expected: Only current owned objects appear in Kingdom Overview. Opening and closing a child restores the current tab. Guild rankings match native visibility and display tied players together.

checks.title: Input and display lifecycle
checks.steps: Hold a lower action during an upper selection change or close. Tap rapidly, add a second finger, background and resume, and toggle or reconnect the lower display while a service or result is open. Recheck upper touch and controller, hotseat, and single-display play.
checks.expected: Stale and repeated input cannot affect a replaced window or selection. The current player and native owner determine the restored deck. Upper controls remain usable.
